name: Infrastructure Physical Model
purpose: Define registered physical Infrastructure identity, placement, containment, Cloud, descriptive IP, reusable model/compatibility knowledge and installed Component history without replacing operational Device Reference identity or introducing Beta 1.0 topology/credential authority.

decisions.decision: Device Reference is the operational cross-domain device identity. A registered Network Element is a physical Infrastructure instance that an operational Device Reference may resolve to without replacing that Device Reference relationship identity.

Every registered Network Element has immutable internal identity, nonblank operational name and exactly one authoritative Site; model, serial, placement, Cloud and descriptive IP data are independently optional facts/relationships.

Physical placement follows Site -> Room -> Rack. A Rack belongs to one Room and therefore one Site; Rack placement may record row, column and position semantics and can never imply a Site different from the Network Element's authoritative Site.

Reusable Model/BOM/component compatibility knowledge is separate from installed Component-instance identity/history. Installed Component instances belong to the physical Network Element and preserve their own placement/slot/serial/chronology facts.
Network Element containment is an acyclic one-parent forest independent from physical Rack placement, Cloud assignment, model compatibility, IP inventory and connectivity.
Cloud Type is reusable reference knowledge; Cloud Deployment is an independently identified Site-scoped instance. A Network Element may belong to at most one same-Site Cloud Deployment.
IP addresses are descriptive zero-many facts with at most one primary address; IP equality or similarity never establishes Network Element identity or topology.
Beta 1.0 has no canonical interfaces, connectivity, reachability, discovery, topology or SSH capability. Placement/IP/containment must not be interpreted as connectivity.
Reusable device/authentication secrets are prohibited from ordinary SOMA Infrastructure/domain/evidence/log/workbook state; Beta 1.0 exposes no device credential or SSH controls.

Infrastructure XLSX exchange is versioned, macro-free and staged before acceptance; external workbook identity/labels are reconciliation evidence, omission/blanks are non-destructive by default, and source workbooks are never modified.
